articles.title: Riverton council approves expanded late-night bus service
articles.excerpt: The Riverton city council voted 7-2 on Monday to extend bus service hours until 2 a.m. on six routes. Supporters said night-shift workers need transit; two council members said the $4 million cost is not yet funded.

articles.title: Riverton votes to extend bus service hours for night workers
articles.excerpt: Riverton's council approved longer bus service hours, a change transit advocates say will help hospital and warehouse workers. Critics on the council questioned how the city will pay the $4 million annual cost.

articles.title: US city Riverton backs longer bus service hours despite funding questions
articles.excerpt: Riverton council members voted to extend bus service on six routes. The final route plan and funding source remain under discussion, officials said.

articles.title: Hurricane Delia makes landfall near Port Arlo as a Category 3 storm
articles.excerpt: Hurricane Delia came ashore near Port Arlo early Tuesday with winds of 120 mph. Officials ordered evacuations along the coast and warned of storm surge flooding.

articles.title: Delia slams Port Arlo, knocking out power to 300,000
articles.excerpt: Hurricane Delia made landfall near Port Arlo, leaving about 300,000 customers without power. Storm surge flooding reached downtown streets, emergency officials said.

articles.title: Hurricane Delia: storm surge floods Port Arlo after landfall
articles.excerpt: Residents of Port Arlo described rising water after Hurricane Delia made landfall. Evacuation orders remain in place and power outages are widespread.

articles.title: Acme Motors recalls 200,000 electric SUVs over battery fire risk
articles.excerpt: Acme Motors is recalling about 200,000 Voltara electric SUVs after reports of battery fires while charging. Owners are advised to park outside until repairs are made.

articles.title: Voltara SUV recall: Acme says battery fires linked to charging
articles.excerpt: Acme Motors said its recall of 200,000 Voltara SUVs follows a dozen battery fires during charging. Regulators said they are reviewing the recall.

articles.title: Norland central bank raises interest rates to 5.5% to fight inflation
articles.excerpt: The Bank of Norland raised its main interest rate by half a point to 5.5%, citing persistent inflation. Business groups warned higher borrowing costs could slow hiring.

articles.title: Bank of Norland hikes interest rates again as inflation stays high
articles.excerpt: Norland's central bank increased interest rates to 5.5%. Unions said the rate rise will hurt mortgage holders while the bank said inflation must come down.

articles.title: Pemberton Museum agrees to return Kalari bronzes
articles.excerpt: The Pemberton Museum said it will return 12 Kalari bronze sculptures taken during a colonial expedition. Kalari officials welcomed the decision and said the bronzes will go on display in the capital.

articles.title: Kalari bronzes to be returned by Pemberton Museum after decades-long campaign
articles.excerpt: The Pemberton Museum will return 12 bronze sculptures to Kalari. Campaigners said the return of the bronzes was overdue; some trustees had argued the museum should keep them.

articles.title: Senator Mara Quinn introduces farm subsidy bill
articles.excerpt: Senator Mara Quinn introduced legislation to expand subsidies for small dairy farms, saying prices have fallen for three years.

articles.title: Senator Mara Quinn hospitalized after car accident
articles.excerpt: Senator Mara Quinn was taken to hospital with minor injuries after a car accident on Interstate 9, her office said.

articles.title: Wildfire forces evacuations in Oregon's Lane County
articles.excerpt: A fast-moving wildfire in Lane County, Oregon, has forced 2,000 residents to evacuate. Firefighters said strong winds are spreading the fire.

articles.title: Wildfire destroys homes in California's Ventura County
articles.excerpt: A wildfire in Ventura County, California, has destroyed 40 homes. Firefighters said dry conditions and strong winds are spreading the fire.
